title: Advanced Foundations Capstone
introduction: The final capstone demonstrates end-to-end engineering judgement under explicit correctness and operational constraints.
learningOutcomes: Design a service with data and external boundaries.

activities.question: Which capstone evidence is strongest?
options: Reproducible tests and measurements tied to requirements
A claim that it seems fast
activities.explanation: Reproducible evidence connects implementation results to explicit requirements.

activities.question: Operational and security constraints belong in the initial capstone scope.
activities.explanation: They affect architecture and cannot be reliably bolted on after every design decision.

activities.question: Order the capstone lifecycle.

items.text: Collect security, correctness and performance evidence

activities.explanation: Design the constraints, build incrementally, gather evidence and then operate and evaluate.
